period: images from 15 Feb 2010 to 5 Feb 2011 (one lunar year of observations)
meaning: percent of observations in which the pixel was sunlit, at surface level
limits: 100 m pixels: the 876 m trip covers only 2 distinct pixels, so routes cannot be compared with this map.
Binary threshold per image and a single year (2010-11); other years differ.
citation: Speyerer, E. J., & Robinson, M. S. (2013). Persistently illuminated regions at the lunar poles: Ideal sites for future exploration. Icarus, 222(1), 122-136. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.icarus.2012.10.010
